citation.authors: Welch AA, Farahani RA, Egan AM, et al.
citation.title: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor blockade impairs islet secretion and glucose metabolism in humans

population.description: The 12 participants without diabetes (the 11 with type 2 diabetes are not entered). Eligibility: no chronic illness, no upper GI surgery, no medication affecting glucose metabolism. On the screening 75 g OGTT none had impaired fasting glucose and 4 had impaired glucose tolerance, so status is unselected rather than healthy. Printed in the text: only a mean BMI of 32 kg/m2 (Discussion), with no spread, so the draw of virtual people cannot use it; and that the two groups were matched for age, sex and weight. Sex and age are in Table 1, which is an image: sex 'mixed' is a placeholder the format requires, not a printed fact, and age is not given.

protocols.name: saline_fasting
protocols.description: Saline-infusion study day in the 12 participants without diabetes, fasting part only. Arm minute 0 is 06:00, which the paper calls -180 min (paper minute 0 is 09:00, arm minute 180), after the standard 10 kcal/kg evening meal and an overnight fast; the fasting window -30 to 0 min is arm minutes 150 to 180 and the arm ends after the sample at 180 (duration 181). During the arm: a trace [3-3H] glucose infusion from 06:00 (not simulated), 0.9% saline from 07:00 (arm 60) in place of exendin 9-39, hand vein warmed to 55 C for arterialized sampling; no glucose is given before paper minute 0 and no meal. The hyperglycemic clamp from 09:00 and everything after it are not entered.
